verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a commerce platform. However, the evidence shows the core services (Store Sync, PayPal Shopping Cart, agentic commerce services, and the remote MCP server at mcp.paypal.com) are PayPal-hosted, form-gated offerings, and merchants only host reverse-API cart endpoints that PayPal calls. The open-source agent toolkit on GitHub and npm is a client SDK that calls PayPal's hosted APIs, not a self-hostable version of the core product, so nothing shows the product itself can be self-hosted.
